title: refactor(plugin-grid): move ObjectGrid's row load into a sibling hook (slice 5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94Cr2fbhp665MVvsYFfqYFe)_

Part of #25994 (slice 5 of the move-only split; slices 1–4 landed as #26323, #26354, #26364 and #26499, and the card stays open for the slices listed below).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `14f30991` (`main` with slice 4). `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is 6307 lines there. This slice moves concerns **K** and **L** of the seam table in #26364, as re-planned in #26499. They are adjacent and above the first early return, so they become one custom hook, `useObjectGridRowLoad`, in the new sibling `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts`, called where the lines stood:

| # | Concern | Lines on `14f30991` |
|---|---|---|
| K | The data-invalidation nonce (`invalidationNonce`) and the unified async load effect: object definition, then rows, totals, `lastFindParamsRef` and the server-grouped row query | 1278–1894 |
| L | The host `findParams` reset of "select all matching" (`hostFindParamsKey`) and the page-1 reset when the query changes | 1896–1923 |
| — | `toOrderByClause` with its docblock (module level) | 104–134 |

`toOrderByClause` moves with the load effect because that effect is its only caller (slice 2 left it beside its call sites for that reason; the call sites now live in the new module). `parseSchemaSort` stays in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, pinned by `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973`. Its docblock's `{@link toOrderByClause}` now names a function in the sibling module; the sentence is unchanged.

The hook takes 35 inputs, passed explicitly and typed from their source; no context is added and no `any` is introduced:

- The values from slice 4's hooks are typed as `ReturnType<typeof useObjectGridQueryInputs>[name]` and `ReturnType<typeof useObjectGridGroupingDecisions>[name]`.
- The rest: `schema: ObjectGridSchema`, `dataSource: DataSource | undefined`, `objectName: string | undefined`, `dataConfig: ViewData | { provider: string; items: unknown[] } | null`, `hasInlineData: boolean`, `perms: ReturnType<typeof usePermissions>`, `refreshKey: number`, `hostFindParams: ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps['findParams']`, `lastFindParamsRef: React.RefObject<Record<string, unknown> | null>`, and the six setters as `React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<…>>` of their state's type. `data` and `objectSchema` are `useState<any…>` in the component, so their setters are typed with `unknown[]` and `unknown` in the hook, and the effect type-checks against that unchanged.

The hook returns `{ invalidationNonce }`, the one name the rest of the component reads (`groupReloadKey`). No identifier is renamed. Nothing new is exported from `ObjectGrid.tsx`, and the package entry is untouched. Twelve import specifiers and the `findParamsSignature` import move with their only readers. `ObjectGrid.tsx` goes from 6307 to 5639 lines. The diff is 1464 changed lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectGrid.tsx` equals the new `ObjectGrid.tsx` plus `objectGridRowLoad.ts`. Nothing is missing except the 4 edited import lines, which differ only by the removed specifiers. The only added lines are the module header and imports, the two `ReturnType` aliases, the hook signature, `return { invalidationNonce };`, and in `ObjectGrid.tsx` the import plus the call with its two-line comment.

## Open PRs on `ObjectGrid.tsx`

None. I checked all 22 open PRs at the claim (06:15Z): none touches `ObjectGrid.tsx`, its `objectGrid*` siblings or `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973.test.tsx`.

## Test edits

One, a path edit, as the seat ruled. `gridArrayArmOrderby-8973.test.tsx` pins `params.$orderby = headerSort.map(…)` in the load effect, now in `objectGridRowLoad.ts`, and `export function parseSchemaSort`, which stays. Its source probe now reads the two files joined:

```diff
-    const src = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, 'packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx'), 'utf8');
+    const src = ['ObjectGrid.tsx', 'objectGridRowLoad.ts']
+      .map((file) => readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, 'packages/plugin-grid/src', file), 'utf8'))
+      .join('\n');
```

Every assertion is unchanged. No other test reads the moved lines as source: I matched every string literal of every source-reading test against the moved lines, and the only other hits were prose in test comments. `column-identity.ratchet` still finds its `columnIdentity(` call in `ObjectGrid.tsx` (line 1859 there).

## Remaining slices

As re-planned in #26499: **6 — N + O + P** (group value formatter and temporal faces, server grouping, bulk fan-out and column summaries), **7 — C + D + E** (row-height sync, column-state persistence, pull to refresh; re-points `gridNonAuthorKeys`' `columnState` reads), **8 — R + U + V** (closes the card; re-points the five `generateColumns` pins).

## Verification

Run on `5345a340` (this head):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2`, the whole package suite, under the verification lock: 253 of 253 files, 2256 of 2256 tests. The before reading is the same count on slice 4 (#26499, CI green on `09fc0d22`).
- The 52 test files outside plugin-grid that read sources (the list slices 1–4 used): 52 of 52 files, 2258 of 2258 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console`: 70 of 70 tasks.
- eslint on the three touched files: 0 errors, and 229 warnings before and after. As in slice 4, the setters now come from the hook's parameters, so two `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` messages name different variables (the load effect's now lists `lastFindParamsRef`, `setData`, `setError`… instead of `setGroupRowQuery`; the `findParams` reset's now names `setSelectAllMatching`), and one `set-state-in-effect` warning is no longer raised. No dependency array changed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived gates, all exit 0 (the `vitest run scripts/` gate ran under the lock: 178 files, 5097 tests); `--ran` reconciles 35 of 35 (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN).

## Landing

No other open PR touches these files, so this can land as soon as CI is green.

Changeset: `.changeset/25994-objectgrid-row-load-hook.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`).
